description: An undefined variable expanded into try's arguments makes the call fail after a success
notes: The README says try evaluates its argument expressions in order until one produces a result without errors, so try(1, ys...) would give 1 without evaluating ys. The native syntax spec says the expression before ... must evaluate to a list or tuple whose elements are mapped to parameters, and neither says whether ys is evaluated before try runs. hashicorp/hcl evaluates the expanded expression before calling the function and reports its error (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), so try never runs.
